abstracted_predicate.name: INTERPRETS_OBSERVED_CONTENT_AS_TYPED_OR_STRUCTURED_INFORMATION
abstracted_predicate.definition: The reasoning interprets an observation of an artifact's raw, low-level, pattern-based, or metadata-bearing content by assigning higher-level semantic organization — such as a resource type, format, structural role, or decoded fields, records, layouts, or values — grounded in identifiable content features, rather than merely restating the observed content.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that assigns an inferred resource type, format, structural role, or decoded structured meaning to the observed content.

parameters.name: content_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the raw, low-level, byte-level, character-level, pattern-based, metadata-bearing, or structurally informative content being interpreted.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains identifiable content features such as a raw or low-level representation, byte or character pattern, embedded string or artifact, occurrence pattern, size or metadata signature, or internal structure.
The reasoning assigns a specific type, format, structural role, or higher-level structured meaning to the observed content, including decoded fields, records, layouts, boundaries, or values.
The interpretation is supported by identifiable features in the observation and goes beyond merely repeating or describing the raw content.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports or restates raw bytes, raw content, size, existence, or metadata without using it to infer a type, format, structural role, or structured interpretation.
The stated type, role, or decoded structure is unsupported by any identifiable feature in the observation.
The observation is unrelated to the stated type, format, structural role, or structured interpretation.
The reasoning merely dismisses the content as noise, filler, or irrelevant without assigning it a type, format, structural role, or structured meaning.
